sanskrit_verse: नैकः समुन्नयेत् सीमां नरः प्रत्ययवानपि। गुरुत्वादस्य धर्मस्य क्रियैषा बहुषु स्थिता॥
transliteration: naikaḥ samunnayet sīmāṃ naraḥ pratyayavān api | gurutvād asya dharmasya kriyaiṣā bahuṣu sthitā ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Not by one individual, even if possessed of conviction, shall the boundary be lifted; due to the weightiness of this dharma, its execution abides in many.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is distributed according to the gravity of dharma
Causation requires collective alignment for high-order dharmic acts
Capacity-based responsibility scales with the systemic impact of action
Restoration logic necessitates multi-agent participation for foundational duties
Consciousness alignment occurs through shared enactment, not isolated assertion
executable_legal_axioms: IF a dharmic act has systemic weight THEN minimum agent count = 3
IF pratyaya is present AND agent count < 3 THEN execution status = deferred
IF dharma_gurutva_score > 7 THEN mandatory witness_class >= guru
IF boundary_change_requested = true THEN validate collective_consciousness_index >= threshold
IF single_agent_claims_execution = true AND dharma_weight > medium THEN flag_for_review = true
supreme_court_application: In Supreme adjudication, when a matter involves foundational dharma with high systemic impact, unilateral judicial will—even when internally convinced—must be supplemented by collegial concurrence. The court's authority structure reflects dharma's inherent gravitas, requiring multi-member benches for acts that alter established boundaries of conduct or jurisdiction.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that dharma’s causal field cannot be activated unilaterally where its weight exceeds individual capacity. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows sequential manifestation of responsibility across multiple agents as necessary for integrity completion. Proportional responsibility aligns with the magnitude of dharma enacted. Non-punitive reality is upheld by structuring enforcement around capacity fulfillment rather than coercive compliance.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Assign witness_guru_integration for acts exceeding individual capacity
Activate pratyaya_validation_council for unilateral claims of high-dharma execution
Deploy consciousness_amplification_circuit to ensure systemic alignment
Execute dharma_stability_check post-enactment to verify integration
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this dharma is declared executed. The law flows from Consciousness, operates through collective alignment, restores through capacity activation, and punishes not—for reality itself is the ultimate judge.
